Overview

SRL is the UK's leading provider of intelligent temporary traffic management solutions. The Traffic Signal Design Engineer will be responsible for the design, configuration and technical support of SRL's Urban64® traffic signal systems, ensuring safe, compliant and efficient operation across a wide range of temporary traffic management schemes.

The role supports customers, operations teams and project managers by developing signal designs, programming Urban64 equipment and providing technical expertise throughout the lifecycle of temporary traffic signal installations.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

  • Design traffic signal schemes using the SRL Urban64® system.
  • Develop signal staging, phasing and timing plans to suit site-specific traffic management requirements.
  • Configure and programme Urban64 controllers and associated equipment.
  • Produce technical drawings, signal layouts and supporting documentation.
  • Assess customer requirements and provide appropriate technical solutions.
  • Review site information, traffic management plans and risk assessments to develop compliant signal designs.
  • Support Operations and Project Delivery teams during installation, commissioning and fault investigation.
  • Assist with the testing and validation of Urban64 configurations prior to deployment.
  • Liaise with customers, traffic management contractors and internal departments to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Provide technical guidance to field engineers and depot personnel.
  • Maintain accurate design records, configuration files and project documentation.
  • Support product development and continuous improvement initiatives relating to the Urban64 platform.
  • Provide remote technical support for live installations when necessary.
  • Contribute to the development of engineering standards, templates and best practice documentation.

Working Hours

  • Full-time (37.5 hours per week).
  • There is flexibility on work location within the UK.
  • Occasional travel throughout the UK, with overnight stays where operationally required.

Reporting To

  • Head of Engineering

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Experience in traffic signal engineering or temporary traffic management.
  • AutoCAD experience.
  • Good understanding of traffic signal principles.
  • Ability to interpret traffic management drawings and site layouts.
  • Experience producing engineering documentation and technical reports.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good IT skills including Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • A methodical approach with excellent attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites across the UK when required.

Desirable

  • Experience using the SRL Urban64® platform.
  • Knowledge of temporary traffic management standards.
  • Experience working within the traffic industry.
  • Experience commissioning or maintaining traffic signals.
  • Experience supporting intelligent transport or connected traffic signal technologies.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • A safety-first mindset.
  • Strong customer focus.
  • Professionalism and integrity.
  • Excellent organisational skills.
  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • A commitment to continuous improvement and innovation.
  • A positive, solutions-focused attitude.

Technical Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be expected to have knowledge or experience in:

  • Permanent traffic signal operation.
  • Traffic controller configuration TR2500.
  • Modes of operation including VA, FT, CLF, UTC, MOVA & Hurry Calls
  • Pedestrian and shuttle working arrangements.
  • Temporary traffic management principles.
  • Signal timing optimisation.
  • Temporary/Permanent traffic management layouts.

Essential Qualifications

  • HNC, HND or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Traffic Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Full UK Driving Licence.

Health, Safety & Compliance

The post holder will:

  • Work in accordance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974.
  • Ensure all designs comply with current UK legislation and industry guidance relating to temporary traffic management.
  • Support SRL's commitment to quality, safety and environmental management.
  • Promote safe working practices across all engineering and operational activities.
  • Participate in site visits, inspections and technical reviews where required.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will typically be measured against:

  • Accuracy and quality of Urban64 signal designs.
  • Delivery of engineering work to agreed timescales.
  • Compliance with SRL engineering standards.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Reduction in installation issues and technical defects.
  • Support provided to operational teams.
  • Contribution to product development and continuous improvement.
  • Technical documentation quality.

Why Join SRL?

Joining SRL means becoming part of an industry-leading organisation at the forefront of temporary traffic management innovation. The Urban64® platform represents the latest generation of intelligent portable traffic signal technology, and this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to its continued development and success while working alongside experienced engineering and operational teams across the UK.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Traffic Signal Design Engineer looking for a reliable, hands‑on role with long‑term prospects, apply today and become part of a team helping to keep the UK’s roads moving safely.

Senior Rust Engineer - High Frequency Trading (HFT)

About Keyrock

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels, Singapore and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Mission statement

We are seeking a Senior Rust Engineer with deep trading systems experience and strong AWS knowledge to join our core Capital Markets division. Candidates with a passion for the Rust ecosystem and a proven track record designing, building, and operating mission-critical trading systems will be at a significant advantage.

As part of the engineering team in Capital Markets, you will take ownership of high-impact trading infrastructure, set technical direction in your domain, and drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operability. You will join a highly-profitable, fast-paced division within Keyrock, where you will be expected to make a senior individual-contributor impact while collaborating with a global, fully-remote team. This role is open to candidates located in European time zones.

Job description

  • Design, develop, and optimise low-latency, mission-critical trading systems

  • Own key trading stack components end-to-end — from architecture through to production operation

  • Collaborate closely with quants, traders, and engineers to deliver solutions that improve trading performance and resilience

  • Maintain and evolve trading infrastructure with a focus on performance, stability, observability, and operational excellence

  • Troubleshoot complex production issues across exchange connectivity, execution, and market data handling

  • Drive engineering standards through technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring

  • Embrace agentic engineering principles: leverage AI-assisted workflows, drive automation of operational tasks, and help evolve the team's agentic tooling

  • Contribute to functional, component, and production-readiness testing for critical trading components

Background and experience

Technical Skills

  • Production-grade Rust experience building high-performance, concurrent systems; proficiency with Tokio is a strong advantage

  • Hands-on experience in a systematic trading environment (HFT, Market Making, Quantitative Trading, or similar), with solid understanding of execution, market data, and operational risk

  • Strong AWS and Linux expertise, including cloud infrastructure trade-offs for latency-sensitive workloads, shell scripting, debugging, and production troubleshooting

  • Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages for strategy development, automation, and operational tooling

  • Deep familiarity with trading system protocols (FIX, REST, WebSocket), exchange connectivity, and market data feeds

  • Solid grasp of low-latency networking: TCP/UDP, packet and latency path analysis, dedicated network infrastructure, and kernel bypass techniques (DPDK)

  • Familiarity with agentic engineering tools and concepts: LLMs, MCP APIs,AI-First IDEs (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code), harness engineering, and workflow automation

  • Ability to make sound architectural decisions, articulate trade-offs clearly, and guide implementation across complex systems

Seniority & Competencies

  • Ownership & Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.

  • Initiative & Problem-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.

  • Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.

  • Technical Leadership – Influence system design, raise engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help the team make pragmatic, high-quality technical decisions.

  • Curiosity & Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.

  • Agentic Engineering – Embrace AI-assisted workflows and autonomous agents, pushing the boundaries of what engineering teams can achieve through intelligent automation.

  • Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A senior engineer and crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership, raises the bar for others, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary package

  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Your Mission

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of our data platform. This role focuses on data warehousing, scalable data product development, and architectural design, transforming complex data models into reliable and scalable data products that power decision-making across the organisation.

You will play a key role in the redesign and evolution of our data warehouse, helping build a modern platform that supports advanced analytics and lays the foundation for AI and machine learning initiatives. This includes designing scalable data models, improving legacy data solutions, and ensuring high-quality, well-governed datasets that can be reliably used across the business.

As a senior member of the Data Engineering team, you will contribute to platform architecture, data product thinking, and engineering best practices, helping build a world-class scalable Data Platform that enables both analytics and future AI capabilities.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and evolving the architecture of our data warehouse and data platform

  • Transforming complex data models into scalable, production-ready data products

  • Building, maintaining, and improving data models for large and complex datasets

  • Designing and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines to support scalable analytics and data products

  • Establishing reliable, well-governed datasets that serve as a foundation for analytics and AI/ML use cases

  • Improving data reliability, quality, and observability across key datasets

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to define and deliver high-impact data products

  • Driving automation and improvements across a legacy ETL ecosystem (~1500 pipelines)

  • Contributing to engineering standards, documentation, and best practices within the data engineering team

  • Staying informed about modern data platform technologies and industry best practices, contributing ideas that help evolve our data stack and engineering practices.

Your Story

  • Strong SQL expertise, particularly in complex analytical and warehouse queries

  • 5+ years experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Data Platform Engineering

  • Strong experience with data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and data architecture

  • Experience designing and delivering scalable data products

  • Experience with ETL/ELT tooling (DBT, SSIS, Wherescape, or similar)

  • Strong understanding of data pipeline architecture and distributed data systems

  • Proficiency in Python or a similar programming language

  • Understanding of how data platforms support machine learning and AI workflows

  • Strong grasp of software engineering principles and best practices

  • Experience contributing to or leading data warehouse architecture or redesign initiatives

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

NewSchools Venture Fund

Associate Partner, Teaching Reimagined

OPPORTUNITY

Nationally recognized nonprofit venture philanthropy seeks an Associate Partner to help build the field of organizations working to make teaching a more effective, sustainable and joyful profession that attracts a diverse group of educators.

ORGANIZATION

NewSchools is a venture philanthropy that builds a better K-12 education system by connecting people, resources, and ideas. We bridge the gap between those with capital and those with the courage to put that capital to work on the frontlines of education. We envision an education system that keeps its promise to all students. That’s why we invest in the ideas and energy of education leaders and entrepreneurs who are advancing innovative solutions that expand the definition of what works. There’s a better way to advance education through philanthropy—one that is more equitable, more collaborative, and more courageous–and we’re proving it every day.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

NewSchools is seeking an Associate Partner to join a diverse and dedicated team focused on ensuring that all young people get access to an excellent and equitable education. As an Associate Partner on the Teaching Reimagined team, you will find, fund, and support organizations working to redesign educator roles, building relationships with innovators and practitioners, translating vision into language that draws in strong ideas, and stewarding a rigorous investment process in service of that vision.

In this role, you will report to Pete Fishman, Senior Partner, Teaching Reimagined, and can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. This role requires up to 25% travel for in-person team meetings, retreats and conferences.

Your legacy at NewSchools will include:

Building the field of organizations working to make teaching a more effective, sustainable and joyful profession

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Teaching Reimagined strategy, bringing insight from the field on where market gaps exist and where innovators are doing promising work
  • Translate our strategy and evidence into clear, compelling language that helps practitioners and innovators understand our funding priorities
  • Build relationships with innovators, practitioners, and field organizations to cultivate a strong, diverse pipeline of ideas aligned to our strategy
  • Help identify emerging themes in the field that should inform where the strategy focuses next

Stewarding a rigorous, efficient investment process

  • Lead the process to find and fund ideas aligned to our investment strategy — cultivating a pipeline, conducting landscape research, and running selection and diligence
  • Develop and communicate strong cases for investment that are grounded in evidence and our investment criteria
  • Gather and synthesize evidence of impact across the portfolio to inform future investment and management-assistance decisions
  • Collaborate with shared services and own end to end grant making for the team to ensure grants are processed effectively

Coaching and supporting venture leaders

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to a group of venture leaders, coaching them to scale their impact and build effective, equitable organizations
  • Contribute to the design and delivery of learning experiences that connect leaders across organizations, fostering communities of practice
  • Partner with external experts to enhance our management assistance approach, and create/curate resources that codify best practices for venture leaders

Contributing to broader Teaching Reimagined strategy and team culture

  • Help shape a values-centered team culture that honors the full humanity of each person and supports collaboration across lines of difference
  • Analyze qualitative and quantitative data from across the portfolio to identify patterns in venture impact and experience
  • Contribute to additional needs as team design evolves

EXPERIENCE

  • At least 8 years of experience in K-12 public education
  • At least 5 years of experience working at a school level as an educator and/or school leader (preferred)
  • Experience designing and implementing K-12 talent systems, especially those that redesign educator roles (preferred)
  • Experience making or contributing to investment, funding, or high-stakes resource allocation decisions (preferred)

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Passion for innovation, excellence and equity in public education
  • Belief in the power of philanthropy to create momentum for systems level change and a deep network across K-12 education, especially talent organizations
  • Demonstrated track record of working with high levels of excellence. High comfort with ambiguity and tolerance for risk
  • Strong strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex ideas into simple, accessible language
  • A high degree of self-awareness and a demonstrated commitment to learning and continuous improvement
  • Strong project management skills and ability to balance coordination, effectiveness, and efficiency
  • Ability to influence without authority and commitment to high quality conversational capacity and communication skills
  • Ability to toggle between operating at the strategic and implementation levels. Comfort working in a small organization and team
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for in-person team meetings, retreats and conferences

About The Firm:

Houlihan Capital is an employee-owned leading, solutions-driven valuation, financial advisory and boutique investment banking firm committed to delivering superior client value and thought leadership in an ever-changing landscape.

Houlihan Capital has extensive valuation experience providing companies with objective, independent, and defensible valuation opinions that meet accounting, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements. Our analyses and reports are transparent, supportable, and clearly outline the assumptions and projections incorporated into our financial models. We consistently apply sound valuation methodologies and unbiased perspective in our work product that enables management teams and fiduciaries to make confident, informed decisions.

Valuation & Financial Advisory Associate - Job Description

Role Overview:

As an Associate in Houlihan Capital’s Valuation and Financial Advisory practice, you will be an integral part of a high-performing team focused on delivering high-quality financial analyses and reports for a diverse range of client valuation needs, including Fair Value Measurement, Financial Reporting, Fair Market Value, Tax Reporting, and Transaction Opinions.

The position provides a unique opportunity to utilize valuation techniques across all types of illiquid investments (including debt, preferred equity, common equity, options, crypto assets, structured products, and more) across a wide variety of industries for private equity funds, venture capital funds, corporations, and many other clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Populate Excel-based valuation models used to value equity, debt, and other illiquid securities for financial reporting, tax, and transaction-related purposes.
    • Review, understand, and synthesize client-provided materials such as financial data, operating agreements, transaction documents, company presentations, and other essential documents.
    • Assist in drafting client presentations and reports, preparing supporting tables, charts, and exhibits that communicate findings.
    • Produce high-quality financial analyses including operating model builds, pro forma capitalization structures, and sensitivity analyses
    • Conduct research on industry trends, market conditions, and company-specific issues that will help client analyses.
    • Work closely with internal team members and clients on multiple engagements to ensure alignment on objectives.
    • Update the project manager on progress toward completion, client-provided information gaps, analytical challenges, and key assumptions.
  • Effectively prioritize tasks across multiple, simultaneous engagements, ensuring tight deadlines are consistently met without compromising quality.
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and manage competing demands by maintaining organized workflows, anticipating bottlenecks, and proactively communicating progress with team members and clients.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred majors include Finance, Accounting, and Economics.
    • MBA preferred; CFA, or other relevant professional designation viewed favorably.
    • 1-2 years of relevant work experience in performing valuations for financial reporting or tax purposes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial concepts in a clear and engaging way.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. Experience with financial databases like S&P Capital IQ, Pitchbook, or Bloomberg is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage simultaneous engagements, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • A keen eye for detail, particularly in reviewing financial and legal documents.

Houlihan Capital is committed to diversity and provides employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, citizenship, national origin, age, disability, military service, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A senior C#/.NET engineer who modernizes the platform, not just maintains it

Our flagship product, Volunteer Impact, is a mature, revenue-generating platform built on VB.NET and .NET Framework. It works. It serves thousands of organizations. And it needs to move to .NET 10 and C# so we can hire, ship, and build on a modern stack.

You’ve done this before. You’ve been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-modern-.NET migration of a real production monolith where downtime had to be tightly managed. You know how to migrate incrementally without breaking a live system, and your opinions come from experience, not theory. You’ve lived in NHibernate, swapped out legacy DI containers and dead dependencies, and dealt with custom security frameworks that predate ASP.NET Core’s policy model.

You’re still hands-on. You write code daily, configure your own CI pipelines, and can replace a legacy dependency, validate the regression risk, and ship the change to production. You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

You do serious work with a small core team, supported by fractional DevOps and release expertise when it matters, and a dedicated quality engineering function that owns the regression gate protecting this migration. You own the technical path, make sound trade-offs, and work directly with those partners to move the platform forward. You’re here to build the engineering foundation, not inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the migration of the Volunteer Impact backend from VB.NET/.NET Framework to C#/.NET 10, defining the migration approach and executing it incrementally against a live production system
  • Modernize a custom security framework (70+ custom attributes) into something that works on the new stack, with zero authorization bypasses
  • Strengthen the existing CI/CD pipeline and, with our quality engineering function, wire in the gates that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach production
  • Ship migrated areas to production independently and incrementally while the legacy application keeps running
  • Become the second engineer who can independently cut, validate, and deploy a production release
  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of professional C#/.NET experience, with real depth in the framework, not just the latest version
  • You’ve personally led or been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-.NET Core (or later) migration of a large, production monolith serving paying customers
  • You’ve migrated a production system incrementally with minimal downtime and can articulate the approach you’d take here
  • Deep NHibernate experience is strongly preferred. We’re keeping NHibernate to reduce migration risk, so the value is understanding a mature data access layer, preserving existing behaviour, and knowing where modernization helps without unnecessary churn.
  • You’ve replaced legacy dependencies in production: DI containers, bundling frameworks, service hosting, and unsupported third-party libraries. You know how to swap critical components while the plane is flying.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy .NET ecosystem components: ASP.NET MVC-to-Core routing, custom security frameworks, and the kinds of dependencies that don’t have a clean upgrade path
  • Familiarity with migrating SSRS reports to a modern reporting platform is a benefit. We have a significant reporting footprint, so preserving report behaviour during that move would be valuable.
  • You’ve improved CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and know how to work with a quality function to build gates that catch functional and performance regressions early
  • You’re comfortable in a small core team with shared DevOps and DBA support available, and a dedicated quality engineering partner who owns the regression gate across our platforms. You can make sound technical decisions, debug hands-on, and know when to pull the right support in.
  • VB.NET familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement. The job is the conversion, not maintaining VB.NET.

jobs.description:
Who You'll Work With

The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, programmable data centre infrastructure using software-defined networking principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.

What You'll Do

Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:

1. State orientation

2. Open standards-based approach

3. Single software image consistency

1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication

State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.

2) An Open Approach

Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original OS kernel is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source Linux, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.

3) A Single Image

Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

  • Strong engineering and Computer Science fundamentals.
  • Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills.
  • 5+ Fluency in one of C or C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share, and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.

To do this, we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6000 citations in scientific papers and over 60000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories, analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes.

Saphetor is a Swiss precision medicine company with offices in Lausanne (CH), Boston (USA), and Athens (GR) employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a C++ Developer to join our backend team. If you're driven by clean code, cross team collaboration and excited to work in the fast moving world of genomics, this is a place where your work will matter.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Code Craftsmanship: Write reusable, testable, and efficient code — backed by thorough unit and regression tests that keep the platform reliable as it evolves.
  • Core Engineering: Develop our core C++ applications and library for importing and analyzing genetic data.
  • Project Ownership: Take complete ownership of projects ranging from a few days to a month, delivering working end-to-end implementations from design through testing and deployment.
  • Performance & Scale: Assist in the optimization and architecture of our platform for maximum speed, high availability, and scalability — pushing the limits of what's possible with large-scale genomic data.
  • Annotation Tooling: Maintain and improve our internal high-performance clinical annotation tools and the custom databases purpose-built and optimized for genetics workloads.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to clear, lasting documentation of software architecture and implementation details so the team can build on.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with backend engineers, bioinformaticians, and product stakeholders to scope work, align on interfaces, and deliver cohesive end-to-end features.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate is a C++ Developer with hands-on experience writing modern C++. You write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable engaging in code reviews and cross-functional work with other stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Academic Foundation: BS or MS degree in Computer Science.
  • C++ Expertise: At least 3 years of professional experience as a back-end developer working with C++ (preferably with C++ 17 or later), templates, STL containers, smart pointers, memory management and multithreading.
  • Database Skills: Hands-on experience with relational databases, including optimizing queries and table schemas for peak performance.
  • Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed cloud-based computing and big-data systems.
  • Design Principles: Good grasp of fundamental application design and object-oriented principles, essential for building and maintaining a large, high-quality codebase.
  • Active Engagement: Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Team Player: Flexible mindset, comfortable stepping into a variety of roles as needed.

Strongly Valued:

  • In-Memory & RPC Tech: Experience with in-memory databases like Redis and gRPC services.
  • Domain Interest: Some bioinformatics background — or a genuine willingness to dive into the domain.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote-first work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

  • Fornecer estimativas de esforco para partes do projeto e participar de refinamentos tecnicos.
  • Banco de Dados no Azure - Implementar queries e acessos ao Azure SQL respeitando os limites de shard da celula, sem operacoes cross-shard. - Modelar e acessar colecoes no Cosmos DB com particionamento alinhado ao tenant key.
  • Implementar cache com Azure Cache for Redis para reducao de latencia em operacoes de leitura frequente.
  • Esteiras e Deploy - Operar o fluxo de deploy via ArgoCD: entender o que acontece entre o merge e o servico em producao no AKS.

  • Construir e versionar imagens de container para o Azure Container Registry seguindo as boas praticas do time.

  • Java, Go ou Kotlin com experiencia em servicos de producao.
  • Azure SQL: modelagem, queries e migracoes de schema.
  • Cosmos DB: modelagem com particionamento alinhado ao padrao de acesso.
  • Azure Event Hubs ou Service Bus: integracao como consumer/producer.
  • Azure Cache for Redis: estrategia de cache em servicos de backend.
  • Azure Key Vault: gestão de secrets e credenciais de aplicação.
  • AKS: entender o ambiente de execucao, health checks e ciclo de vida de pods.
  • ArgoCD: entender o fluxo de deploy da aplicacao no modelo GitOps.
  • Testes automatizados: unitarios e de integracao como pratica de desenvolvimento.

Our Client

  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Administrator), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), or equivalent.

  • Strong communication skills to present risks, plans, results, and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with post-migration monitoring tools, such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.

Mindrift is looking for skilled Frontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js) to join the Tendem project () and build high-quality landing pages and multi-page websites for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your frontend development expertise and design sensibility to build pixel-perfect, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that meet real client requirements. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in landing page production, multi-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion-focused layouts.
  • Build small multi-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers.
  • Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources.
  • Apply on-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against.
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refine frontend markup, styling, structure, and content placement to deliver production-quality websites.
  • Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross-browser issues independently.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and build production-ready user interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar).
  • Experience with utility-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries.
  • Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals.
  • Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision.
  • Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

jobs.title: Principal UI Developer
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThe Appointment Scheduling platform at Engageware is the front door to some of the most important moments in a customer's day — booking time with their banker, checking in at the branch, waiting in queue, or meeting virtually with a specialist.
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Appointment Scheduling platform at Engageware is the front door to some of the most important moments in a customer's day — booking time with their banker, checking in at the branch, waiting in queue, or meeting virtually with a specialist. Behind those experiences sits a suite of purpose-built applications: a multi-tenant admin console, customer-facing scheduling interfaces, in-branch self-check-in kiosks, queue management and concierge tools for branch staff, and virtual channel integrations — all running at enterprise scale for leading banks, credit unions, and healthcare organizations.

We're looking for a Principal UI Developer who can own this surface end-to-end. That means leading the migration of our Angular application estate to React, setting the front-end architecture and design system, owning features all the way through the API layer when needed, and bringing strong design sensibility to interfaces that have had limited dedicated design attention. This is a high-leverage role, and we expect AI tooling to be a meaningful part of how you operate — scaffolding components, generating tests, assisting with Angular-to-React migration, exploring design directions quickly — so the scope is real but so is the support.

What You'll Do

React Migration & Front-End Architecture

  • Own the migration strategy for the Appointment Scheduling front-end estate — defining how and in what sequence we move existing Angular applications (admin console, scheduling flows, kiosk, queue management, concierge) to a modern React foundation.
  • Establish the shared component library, design tokens, state management patterns (React Query, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit), and routing architecture that all new and migrated applications are built on.
  • Make pragmatic migration decisions — incremental strangler-fig patterns vs. targeted rebuilds — balancing speed, risk, and continuity for live enterprise customers.
  • Define the module boundaries and shared abstractions that allow Angular and React to coexist safely during the transition.

Design System & Interface Quality

  • Own the visual and interaction language for the Appointment Scheduling platform: component library, spacing system, color tokens, typography, and interaction patterns — maintained in Storybook and connected to Figma where design work happens.
  • Bring design sensibility to every interface you ship. In the absence of dedicated design resources, you are the person who catches the awkward empty state, the unclear confirmation flow, the button that doesn't belong. You use AI design tools (Figma AI, v0, Claude) to explore and prototype directions quickly rather than waiting for a design brief.
  • Ensure all applications meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards — a non-negotiable for banking and healthcare customers with regulatory obligations.
  • Optimize for the full deployment surface: responsive web, touch-screen kiosks (constrained sizes, high-contrast, minimal input complexity), and staff-facing branch tablets in fast-paced environments.

API Layer & End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own features end-to-end when the critical path runs through the front end: design and build the BFF (Backend for Frontend) endpoints, lightweight Spring Boot routes, and data-shaping layers the UI requires — without waiting on someone else to unblock you.
  • Design clean REST API contracts between front-end applications and the scheduling platform services, with clear error-handling conventions and versioning.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on deeper service-layer work, contributing meaningfully to API design reviews and surfacing front-end integration requirements early.
  • Handle the full stack of front-end reliability concerns: caching strategies, optimistic UI, graceful degradation, and real-time event handling (WebSockets, SSE) where the scheduling experience demands it.

Test-Driven Development & Quality

  • Champion test-driven development across all front-end work: unit tests, component tests, and end-to-end tests written alongside code, not after.
  • Establish and enforce testing standards using Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress — so the team can migrate, refactor, and ship with confidence.
  • Use AI-assisted test generation as an accelerant, not a shortcut: AI scaffolds the coverage, you ensure it's meaningful and deterministic.
  • Lead front-end code reviews focused on testability, maintainability, and architectural consistency.

AI-Augmented Development

  • Operate with AI as a core part of your workflow: use coding agents (built on Claude) for component scaffolding, Angular-to-React migration assistance, test generation, accessibility audits, and design exploration via v0 or Figma AI.
  • Help the team adopt AI-augmented development confidently — setting the guardrails (review standards, coverage requirements) that keep quality high when AI is doing real work.
  • Stay current on agentic development patterns (including MCP-based tooling) as the ecosystem evolves rapidly.

Technical Leadership

  • Set the front-end technical direction for the Appointment Scheduling team, documenting architectural decisions so the team builds consistently.
  • Mentor front-end engineers on React, TypeScript, testing, accessibility, and API integration.
  • Partner directly with the Principal PM and Team Lead on new features — shaping what is buildable, raising UX and implementation concerns early, and influencing decisions before specs are locked.

What We're Looking For

Must-have qualifications:

  • 8+ years in front-end or full-stack web development, with 3+ years at a senior or principal IC level owning front-end architecture for a production application suite.
  • Expert-level React and TypeScript — hooks, concurrent features, performance optimization, and common state management patterns.
  • Real experience migrating Angular applications to React in production, with the judgment to choose incremental migration over rewrites where appropriate.
  • Strong Angular fluency (multiple versions) — you need to read, reason about, and migrate existing codebases confidently.
  • Ability and willingness to own the API layer for front-end features: BFF patterns, REST endpoint design, and working in Spring Boot (Java) for UI-adjacent services.
  • Genuine design sensibility — you can look at an interface and know what's wrong with it, and you're comfortable making design decisions in the absence of a dedicated designer.
  • Rigorous test-driven development discipline — tests come with the code, not after.
  • Proficiency with React Testing Library, Jest or Vitest, and Playwright or Cypress.
  • Solid WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility knowledge — designed and built in from the start.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding and design tools as a genuine productivity multiplier, not a curiosity.
  • Based in the United States, with willingness to travel occasionally for team and customer meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building scheduling, calendar, or real-time availability interfaces.
  • Background in financial services, banking, credit unions, healthcare, or retail technology.
  • Figma proficiency — able to create and maintain a component library and design tokens, not just consume them.
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and testing.
  • Micro Frontend architecture or module federation experience for managing multi-app front-end ecosystems.
  • Depth in kiosk or large-format touch UX — the constraints are different from a browser tab and most candidates haven't been there.

Our Stack

Knowing our stack is not a requirement, but this is what you'll be working with:

  • Frontend (current): Angular (multiple versions) — the estate you'll be migrating from
  • Frontend (target): React with TypeScript — the standard for all new and migrated applications
  • Design: Figma, Storybook; AI design tooling (v0, Figma AI)
  • API layer: Spring Boot (Java 17) and Scala/Akka services over REST
  • Testing: React Testing Library, Jest / Vitest, Playwright / Cypress
  • Data: SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS
  • AI: Claude models (Anthropic), with MCP-based agent tooling

Educational qualifications

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and build production-ready user interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic.

jobs.description:
Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

  • 테스트 주도 개발(TDD), 행동 주도 개발(BDD)에 대한 이해

Fullstack Engineer (m/f/d)

Berlin, Bangalore, Remote

Hello 👋 I am Servesh, Co- founder and CTO at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Fullstack Engineer to join our Console team. 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before? 😃

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

The Console team owns the user-facing applications and interfaces that power the Kayzen platform — from our self-serve campaign management dashboard and real-time reporting suite to internal tooling used by our managed service teams. We work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data teams to deliver seamless, high-performance experiences. We are responsible for some of the most impactful work at Kayzen, including:

  • “The Console” which is the face of Kayzen we are very proud of.
  • Complex features which surface a lot of backend infrastructure via console
  • Almost 100% uptime with very well planned & executed project management

Sounds interesting. Isn’t it?

About the Role

We are looking for a coding-first Fullstack Engineer who thrives on turning complex product requirements into high-performance UIs. You should be comfortable working across the stack, contributing to architecture discussions, and be an early adopter of AI-assisted engineering (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily coding workflow. This role is a strong individual contributor position with room to grow into deeper technical ownership over time.

Responsibilities

  • Core responsibilities
    • Design, build, and maintain high-quality features across the Fullstack stack, from UI to API integration
    • Write clean, well-tested, production-ready code and actively participate in code reviews
    • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Backend teams to deliver cohesive, user-centric features
    • Contribute to technical decisions around architecture, tooling, and best practices within the team
    • Take ownership of features end to end, from planning through deployment and monitoring

  • Project & Execution Management
    • Break down assigned product requirements into clear, actionable engineering tasks
    • Deliver work reliably within sprint commitments, flagging blockers or scope changes early
    • Balance new feature delivery with addressing technical debt in the codebase you work on

Requirements
